On-device helper for Idle Obelisk Miner
Unofficial community companion · not affiliated with Checkbox Entertainment.
The accessibility service reads the visible game screen using on-device OCR. It only acts while Idle Obelisk Miner is foregrounded. No screenshots leave this device.

Auto-prestige is off by default. Manual mode is on by default. Prestige confirmation can reset game progress; automatic flow requires a recognized prestige menu, then a distinct explicit confirmation screen and a readable Confirm label or calibrated final point. Check the preview before enabling it.

The advisor uses the game\'s published prestige-points formula and your observed time per level. It compares current PP/hour with the next five-level estimate, accounting for slowing level-ups. It needs at least three measured level-ups after level 20; it does not read or assume hidden XP values.

With the game open, the service keeps a private recent screenshot and reports its pixel size and detected menu. It can locate readable Claim, Continue, and Confirm labels directly from OCR; use calibration for unlabeled icons, close buttons, and controls OCR cannot find. Tap each selected point on the screenshot. Coordinates scale to the captured screen size, but recalibrate after major layout or orientation changes.
Recognized text will appear here when the game is foregrounded.
Detected game screen and captured resolution will appear here.

This app uses Android Accessibility only after you explicitly enable its service. It does not access game files, send data, or bypass the game. ADB-free on-device automation requires Android 11 or newer. OCR and fixed screen coordinates can fail when the layout, language, or game version changes; automatic actions remain disabled until you turn them on.
Game screenshot. Tap a control to calibrate its screen position.
